description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultStreamIdMapper class in the Orleans.Streaming.Core namespace. It provides methods to map StreamId objects to grain key IDs based on binding types and options, supporting GUID and integer key types.

classes.name: DefaultStreamIdMapper
classes.description: Implements the IStreamIdMapper interface to provide mapping between stream identifiers and grain key IDs, supporting GUID and integer keys based on grain binding properties.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Determines the grain key ID span based on the provided StreamId, GrainBindings, and binding properties, considering the key type and namespace inclusion.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Generates a GUID-based grain key, optionally including the namespace in the key, based on the streamId key and binding settings.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Generates an integer-based grain key, optionally including the namespace, based on the streamId key and binding settings.
